title: Single-family 110% condition date: 30% of the works done
instrument: DL 50/2022 as converted (condition restated in DL 176/2022 and L. 197/2022)
what_it_changed: Single-family houses and independent units keep 110% for expenses to 2023-03-31 only if at least 30% of the works were done at 2022-09-30

title: Aiuti-quater decree published
what_it_changed: Superbonus rate for 2023 cut from 110% to 90% with exemptions dated 2022-11-25
sources: https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.legge:2022-11-18;176 (GU n. 270 of 18 November); https://ance.it/wp-content/uploads/allegati/Circolare_509_C_2022.pdf (circular of 2022-11-21: published in GURI n. 270 of 18.11.2022); https://documenti.camera.it/leg19/dossier/testi/D22176b.htm

title: 110% kept for 2023 if the CILA was filed by this date (condominiums: assembly resolution before it)
what_it_changed: The key cut-off for works starting in 2023: filed by 2022-11-25 (assembly by 2022-11-24) stays at 110%; the rest drops to 90% in 2023
sources: https://documenti.camera.it/leg19/dossier/testi/FI0002.htm (Camera dossier: 25 November 2022); https://ance.it/wp-content/uploads/allegati/Circolare_509_C_2022.pdf (key date 24 November for the assembly); https://enna.ance.it/2023/01/10/le-novita-sui-bonus-edilizi-dal-2023/?print=pdf (CILA by 25 November 2022)

title: Minister announces the CILAS extension to 2022-12-31 for the budget law
instrument: Statement of the Minister of Economy at a press conference; the amendment is then in the Government's maxi-amendment to the budget law (L. 197/2022)
what_it_changed: Condominiums with a resolution adopted by 2022-11-18 get until 2022-12-31 to file the CILAS and keep 110% in 2023
sources: https://www.informazionefiscale.it/superbonus-proroga-2023-scadenza-cilas (article of 2022-12-19: announced on 15 December); https://www.rinnovabili.it/green-building/legge-bilancio-2023-superbonus-cilas-18-novembre/ (article of 2022-12-20 reporting the maxi-amendment; a different day)

title: Budget law 2023 published
what_it_changed: Remodulates the 2023 Superbonus by beneficiary (condominium resolutions before 2022-11-18 with CILA by 2022-12-31; 90% for single-family only with income up to 15 thousand euro)

title: Aiuti-quater converted into law
sources: https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.legge:2022-11-18;176 (one source; the date of the law is the same in the Normattiva header)

title: Stop to credit transfer and invoice discount published
what_it_changed: Ends the options of transfer and invoice discount for new works from 2023-02-17 (exemptions for a CILA or resolution before that date)
sources: https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.legge:2023-02-16;11 (GU n. 40 of 16 February; in force 17 February); https://www.assolombarda.it/servizi/fisco/informazioni/bonus-edilizi-stop-alla-cessione-del-credito-e-allo-sconto-in-fattura (from 17 February 2023); https://documenti.camera.it/leg19/dossier/testi/FI0002.htm (ban not applying to options dated before 17 February 2023)

title: Chamber Finance Committee approves the amendment moving the single-family deadline to 2023-09-30
instrument: A.C. 889 (conversion of DL 11/2023), VI Commissione, amendment 01.03
what_it_changed: Single-family 110% (art. 119 c. 8-bis DL 34/2020) deadline moved from 2023-03-31 to 2023-09-30, four days before it expired
sources: https://documenti.camera.it/leg19/resoconti/commissioni/bollettini/html/2023/03/27/06/allegato.htm (Camera bulletin n. 83 of 27 March 2023, approved proposals); https://www.danilotorresi.it/2023/03/29/cessione-del-credito-ultime-notizie-tutti-gli-emendamenti-ad-oggi-approvati-al-dl-11-2023-parte-2/ (approved on 27 March; a trade article of the same morning still listed it as pending)

title: MEF note: amendments to DL 11/2023 extend the single-family 110% to 2023-09-30
instrument: MEF note of 2023-03-30 on two amendments approved at first reading
what_it_changed: Single-family 110% extended from 2023-03-31 to 2023-09-30 (30% condition unchanged) and remissione in bonis for late transfer communications
sources: https://www.pmi.it/impresa/normativa/402892/superbonus-villette-2023-stop-proroga-a-giugno-110-fino-a-marzo.html (trade press quoting the MEF note); https://ragusa.ance.it/2023/04/03/circolare-n164-c-2023-superbonus-110-sulle-unifamiliari-prorogato-il-termine-ultimo-al-30-settembre-2023/ (ANCE circular of 2023-04-03; a different day)

title: Chamber confidence vote on the conversion bill of DL 11/2023
what_it_changed: The text with the committee's amendments is put to a confidence vote (185 for, 121 against)

title: Chamber final vote on the conversion bill of DL 11/2023
instrument: Chamber floor, A.C. 889 (172 for, 114 against, 1 abstention)
what_it_changed: Text approved by the Chamber and sent to the Senate

title: Senate confidence vote and final approval of the conversion bill of DL 11/2023
what_it_changed: Conversion completed without changes; law 38/2023 of 2023-04-11

title: DL 11/2023 converted into law
what_it_changed: Conversion with the single-family extension to 2023-09-30 and the transitional exemptions
sources: https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.legge:2023-02-16;11 (converted by L. 11 April 2023 n. 38); https://enna.ance.it/2023/04/14/decreto-cessione-dei-crediti-il-dl-11-2023-diventa-legge/ (ANCE note of 2023-04-14)
